Load hoopR NBA official injury reports

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_injury_report.Rd

Loads the nba_stats_injury_report release: every entry of the league's official game-day injury reports (the PDFs the NBA posts several times a day), one row per player per game per report, with the player's status (Out, Questionable, ...), the reason, the status on the previous report, and the NBA Stats game_id / team_id / person_id the entry was matched to.

Usage

load_nba_stats_injury_report(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_injury_report release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_injury_report, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year (e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season). Published coverage starts at 2018 (2018-19). Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player per game per report.

col_nametypesdescription
seasonintegerSeason as its ENDING year (2026 = the 2025-26 season), the published asset's stamp.
report_datetimePOSIXctPublish time of the report version the row comes from (US Eastern, naive). The league re-publishes the report through the day, so a listing repeats once per version.
game_dateDateGame date as the report prints it (US Eastern).
game_timecharacterTip time as the report prints it ("07:30 (ET)", no AM/PM).
report_matchupcharacterGame as the report prints it, away@home tricodes ("CLE@ATL").
away_team_abbrcharacterAway team tricode as the report prints it.
home_team_abbrcharacterHome team tricode as the report prints it.
teamcharacterTeam the listing belongs to, full name as printed ("Cleveland Cavaliers").
report_player_namecharacterPlayer as the report prints it, "Last, First" ("James, LeBron"); NA on a team's NOT YET SUBMITTED row.
current_statuscharacterListed status in that version: Available, Probable, Questionable, Doubtful or Out; NA on a NOT YET SUBMITTED row.
reasoncharacterReason as printed ("Injury/Illness - Left Ankle; Sprain"); "NOT YET SUBMITTED" for a team that had not filed by that version.
categorycharacterCategory column of the early report format; last printed 2019-11-14, NA after.
previous_statuscharacterPrevious Status column of the early report format; last printed 2019-12-17, NA after.
game_idcharacterstats.nba.com game id, joined on the game date and tricodes; NA for a game postponed off its printed date, a playoff game that was not needed, or a Summer League game.
team_idintegerstats.nba.com team id of the listing's team, from its printed name.
person_idintegerstats.nba.com person id matched from the printed name (see match_method); NA when unmatched.
match_methodcharacterHow person_id was matched: exact (full name on the team's boxscores that season), family (family name and first initial, unique on the team), league (name unique league-wide that season), roster (name on the team's roster, which lists players who have not played), or NA.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data, and the Python twin sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_injury_report().

Other NBA Stats loader functions: load_nba_stats_coaches(), load_nba_stats_draft_combine, load_nba_stats_game_matchups(), load_nba_stats_hustle, load_nba_stats_leaguedash(), load_nba_stats_matchups(), load_nba_stats_metric_curves(), load_nba_stats_rolling_windows(), load_nba_stats_synergy()
